title: carex parryana var. unica

The plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Carex parryana var. unica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
